digest.component_or_area: CLI guide discovery and commit-trailer documentation
propositions: Clients using rebar CLI without a checkout encounter dangling internal cross-references in CLI-served author guides because links use consumer-relative paths.
The commit-trailer format (EXPECTED_FORMAT in verify_commit.py) has no CLI-discoverable home; only rebar verify-commit-ticket --help documents it.
Packaged guides must repoint all dangling references to use either hosted URLs (https://github.com/navapbc/rebar/blob/main/…) for repo-only docs or rebar explain <topic> for sibling packaged guides.
A new packaged guide src/rebar/_guides/commit-ticket-trailer.md must be registered in AUTHOR_GUIDES and discoverable via rebar explain commit-trailer.
A guard test must enforce that no packaged guide contains consumer-relative markdown link targets or bare repo paths, and that every rebar explain <topic> citation names a real registered guide.
